required.asked_by: tell me which host the failing task could not connect to
required.rationale: the handshake target named in the fatal line's url of both job logs (and their failed events). It occurs in no Icinga row and not in the instruction. The one required fact the logs alone earn; the short name is a substring of the FQDN, so either spelling earns it

required.asked_by: tell me which host the alert is on
required.rationale: the host of the only non-OK row get_problems returns. Icinga-only: it is in no job log or event and not in the instruction. It is a different host from proxy-host, which is how the answer carries 'the alert is on another host'

the distinctive part of the alert's attrs.last_check_result.output: the HTTP 500 / Internal Server Error status, or the CIM provider (sfcb, cim provider, cim sensor). Icinga-only: nothing in either job log or event, nor the instruction, carries a 500 status, 'Internal Server Error', sfcb or cim. Never a bare number
